progress.source_title: President Obama Delivers Morehouse College Commencement Address
before: Not because the bitter legacy of slavery and segregation have vanished entirely; they have not.
Not because racism and discrimination no longer exist; we know those are still out there.
after: You now hail from a lineage and legacy of immeasurably strong men -- men who bore tremendous burdens and still laid the stones for the path on which we now walk.

You wear the mantle of Frederick Douglass and Booker T. Washington, and Ralph Bunche and Langston Hughes, and George Washington Carver and Ralph Abernathy and Thurgood Marshall, and, yes, Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. These men were many thin
